Uganda U17 vs France U17: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of the final group stage match of the FIFA U-17 World Cup in Group K, where Uganda faces France. For France, this is a chance to secure the top spot; for Uganda, a final opportunity to fight for qualification.

Kick-off: November 11, 2025, 12:30 UTC 15:30 MSK Stadium: Aspire Zone - Pitch 3, Doha Competition: FIFA U-17 World Cup

Uganda U17 vs France U17: Match Preview

The two sides enter the match with contrasting goals. France, the reigning U-17 European champions, top the group after a 2-0 victory over Chile. Uganda, following a 2-1 loss to Canada, must win to stay in contention for the knockout rounds. This is the first-ever official U-17 meeting between the two nations.

Team Form and Analysis

Uganda U17

The 'Junior Cranes' rely on physical strength, pace, and determination. After their opening defeat, they need a win to keep their hopes alive. Facing France, Uganda are expected to play defensively and look for counter-attacks.

France U17

'Les Bleuets' feature an exceptionally talented generation from PSG, Lyon, and Bayern Munich academies. They prioritize possession, creativity, and technical precision. Mathys Tel leads the attack and is one of Europe's brightest prospects. Even with potential rotation, France remain overwhelming favorites.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Uganda U17 4-4-2: Oyerot; Mutebi, Oyaa, Lali, Kasanya; Okello, Ssebufu, Mugisha, Kirei; Sentamu, Irimba.
  • France U17 4-3-3: Arnyi; Sangi, Tchapto, Sarr, Belocian; Bouneb, Atangana, Doue; Gomis, Tel, Lambourde.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

France are overwhelming favorites due to their technical superiority and depth. Uganda will likely defend deep, but stopping the European champions will be a daunting task.

  • Main Prediction: France to Win (-2.5 Handicap). Expect a dominant performance from France as they aim to secure first place.
  • Total Goals Prediction: France to Win to Nil. Les Bleuets' solid defense should comfortably handle Uganda's limited attacking threat.

USA U17 vs France U17: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of one of the most anticipated matches of the FIFA U-17 World Cup group stage in Qatar, featuring two tournament favorites – the USA and France. This clash promises to be a true highlight of the group stage and a battle for the top spot.

Kick-off: November 11, 2025, 15:45 UTC (18:45 MSK) Stadium: Al Thumama Stadium, Doha Competition: FIFA U-17 World Cup

USA U17 vs France U17: Match Preview

Both teams come into this match as the main contenders for the tournament victory. France, the reigning U-17 European champions, demonstrated their power in the qualifiers, leaving no chance for their opponents. The USA, in turn, are the CONCACAF champions and are traditionally one of the strongest teams at the youth level. This match will be a real test of ambition for both national teams. The history of encounters between these U-17 teams is not extensive, which adds unpredictability to the duel.

Team Form and Analysis

USA U17

The 'Stars and Stripes,' under coach Gonzalo Pineda Jr., rely on athletic, fast, and tactically astute football. American youth teams are always distinguished by their excellent physical conditioning and discipline. A player to watch in the squad is forward Cade Cowell, who has already made a name for himself at the senior level. The Americans will try to impose a high tempo and use their chances in fast attacks.

France U17

'Les Bleuets' (The Little Blues) have brought an incredibly talented generation of players from the academies of PSG, Lyon, and other top clubs to the tournament. The team focuses on ball control, technical superiority, and high individual skill. The leader of their attack is Bayern Munich forward Mathys Tel, who is considered one of the top talents of his age group in the world. France will aim to dominate from the first minutes and prove their favorite status.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • USA U17 (4-3-3): Schurre; Halliday, Craig, Hall, Vazquez; Habroune, Obi, Cisneros; Figueroa, Berchimas, Cowell.
  • France U17 (4-3-3): Argney; Sangu, Tchapchet, Sarr, Belocian; Bouneb, A'Tangana, Doué; Gomis, Tel, Lambourde.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

This is a battle between two evenly matched top national teams. France appears to be a slight favorite due to the higher individual skill of its players. However, the Americans are capable of neutralizing this with their organization and athleticism.

  • Main Prediction: Draw. In a match between two favorites in the group stage, where the cost of a mistake is high, a draw that would suit both teams looks the most likely outcome.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Both teams to score. This is a meeting of two powerful attacking teams, and it is unlikely that either will manage to keep a clean sheet. An exchange of goals is expected.

Republic of Ireland U17 vs Paraguay U17: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of the final group stage match of the FIFA U-17 World Cup in Group E, where the Republic of Ireland takes on Paraguay. Both teams need a win to secure a spot in the knockout stages.

Kick-off: November 11, 2025, 13:30 UTC 16:30 MSK Stadium: Al Thumama Stadium, Doha Competition: FIFA U-17 World Cup

Republic of Ireland U17 vs Paraguay U17: Match Preview

Both sides enter this decisive game near the top of the group standings. Ireland and Paraguay have shown solid performances and now fight for direct qualification to the Round of 16. Paraguay, semi-finalists of the latest U-17 Copa América, are known for resilience and tactical balance. Ireland, quarter-finalists of the last U-17 Euro, rely on strength and discipline. This will be their first-ever official meeting at U-17 level.

Team Form and Analysis

Republic of Ireland U17

Colin O'Brien's team favors physical play, pressing, and set pieces. They are disciplined and organized, always battling for possession. Mason Melia leads the attack and is capable of creating decisive moments with minimal chances.

Paraguay U17

'La Albirroja' combine South American technique with tactical discipline. They rely on quick counter-attacks and compact defending. Key players include forwards Fernández and Jiménez, who provide pace and creativity in attack.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Ireland U17 4-2-3-1: Healy; Babatunde, O'Sullivan, Gannon, O'Brien; Razi, Akachukwu; Devany, Moore, Orun-Agbende; Melia.
  • Paraguay U17 4-4-2: González; Cabral, Benítez, Ávalos, Riveros; Romero, Ortiz, Villalba, Acosta; Fernández, Jiménez.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

An evenly matched contest is expected, with both sides focusing on defensive solidity and minimizing errors.

  • Main Prediction: Draw. A cautious tactical battle with both teams content to share points.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. Expect a tight, low-scoring affair decided by small details.

Uzbekistan U17 vs Panama U17: Live Stream & Watch Online

Welcome to the live broadcast of the final group stage match of the FIFA U-17 World Cup in Group E, featuring Uzbekistan against Panama. For both sides, this match is the last chance to stay in contention for the knockout stage.

Kick-off: November 11, 2025, 13:30 UTC 16:30 MSK Stadium: Al Thumama Stadium, Doha Competition: FIFA U-17 World Cup

Uzbekistan U17 vs Panama U17: Match Preview

Both teams lost their first two matches and sit at the bottom of the group. Uzbekistan fell 0-1 to Ireland and 0-2 to Paraguay without scoring a goal. Panama were beaten 0-4 by Paraguay and 1-2 by Ireland. This is effectively a 'match for pride,' and the winner could still have a slim chance of progressing as one of the best third-placed teams. It will be their first official meeting at U-17 level.

Team Form and Analysis

Uzbekistan U17

The 'White Wolves,' coached by Jamoliddin Rakhmatullaev, play an organized and technical style but have struggled to convert chances. They control possession well but lack finishing. Key players include Amirbek Saidov and Lazizbek Mirzaev, who will be under pressure to deliver.

Panama U17

'Los Canaleros' have struggled defensively, conceding six goals in two games. Their strengths are pace and physicality, but they have found it difficult to cope with structured opponents. They are likely to rely on counter-attacks against the technically superior Uzbeks.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Uzbekistan U17 4-2-3-1: Sobirov; Djumaev, Abdullaev, Djuraev, Abdulboriev; Reimov, Urinboev; Mirzaev, Shukurullaev, Sobirov; Saidov.
  • Panama U17 4-3-3: Pérez; Díaz, Rojas, Dawkins, González; Vargas, Tejada, Ramos; Molina, Blackburn, Contreras.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Both teams will fight to end their campaign on a positive note. Uzbekistan seem slightly stronger in structure and creativity, while Panama will rely on their athletic edge.

  • Main Prediction: Uzbekistan to Win. Their superior organization and technique should finally bring goals and a victory.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. Both teams need a win and are likely to play open attacking football.

Burkina Faso U17 vs Tajikistan U17: Watch Live Stream Online - FIFA U-17 World Cup 11.11.2025

Join us for the live broadcast of a group stage match in the FIFA U-17 World Cup, where the Burkina Faso national team will face the national team of Tajikistan. This is a decisive match for both teams as they fight for a place in the tournament's knockout stage.

Date and Kick-off Time: November 11, 2025, 14:45 UTC 17:45 MSK.

Match Preview and Team Form

The Burkina Faso national team comes into this match in 3rd place in their group. In the opening two rounds, the African team secured one victory and suffered one defeat. The African champions display an athletic and powerful style of football but have struggled with consistency. In their last five matches across all competitions, Burkina Faso has won three and lost two.

The Tajikistan national team is in last place, 4th, in the group, having suffered two defeats in their opening two matches. The team shows a fighting spirit but lacks the class and experience at this high level. In their last five matches, the Tajik team has lost three times and drawn twice, conceding 14 goals. To keep their hopes of advancing from the group alive, the team needs nothing less than a victory.

Head-to-Head History

There have been no previous official meetings between these youth national teams. This will be their first-ever head-to-head encounter, which adds an element of unpredictability to the match.

Burkina Faso U17 vs Tajikistan U17 Prediction

Experts and bookmakers consider the Burkina Faso national team the favorite for the upcoming match. Their physical power, higher class, and successful experience in their continental championship are compelling arguments. It will be extremely difficult for Tajikistan to stand up to the athletic African side.

  • Likely Outcome: A victory for Burkina Faso U17. The African team looks significantly stronger and will be aiming to secure their place in the knockout stage.
  • Total Goals Bet: Considering Tajikistan's defensive problems, a bet on 'Over 2.5 goals' looks very likely.
  • Key Factor: Burkina Faso's superiority in physical conditioning and player quality versus the determination but limited capabilities of the Tajikistan team.

Tune into the Burkina Faso U17 vs Tajikistan U17 live stream on tutsport.net and follow the decisive games of the FIFA U-17 World Cup!

Czechia U17 vs United States U17: Watch Live Stream Online - FIFA U-17 World Cup 11.11.2025

Join us for the live broadcast of the final round of the group stage of the FIFA U-17 World Cup, where the Czech Republic national team will face the United States national team. This is the decisive game for first place in the group, as both teams have already secured their spots in the knockout stage.

Date and Kick-off Time: November 11, 2025, 14:45 UTC 17:45 MSK.

Match Preview and Team Form

The Czech Republic is having a very strong tournament. In the first round, the Czechs thrashed Tajikistan 6-1, but unfortunately lost 1-2 to Burkina Faso in the second match. The team is playing incredibly high-scoring football, having netted 29 goals in their last five matches. The Czechs will be aiming for a victory to secure first place in the group and get a more favorable opponent in the playoffs.

The United States is the group leader, having won both of their opening matches. The Americans defeated Burkina Faso 1-0 and Tajikistan. The team displays a very pragmatic and organized style of football. In their last five matches, the USA has secured four victories, which speaks to their excellent form. A draw in this match will guarantee them first place in the group.

Head-to-Head History

In their only head-to-head meeting, which took place in 2011, the United States emerged victorious with a 3-0 scoreline.

Czechia U17 vs United States U17 Prediction

Despite the Czechs' impressive goal-scoring record, bookmakers and experts consider the USA a slight favorite. Their organized play and status as group leaders are compelling arguments. A tense battle between two strong and motivated teams is expected.

  • Likely Outcome: A victory for USA U17. The Americans appear to be a more balanced team and will be looking to finish the group stage with a perfect record.
  • Total Goals Bet: Both teams score a lot. A bet on 'Over 2.5 goals' and 'Both Teams to Score' looks very likely.
  • Key Factor: The battle for first place in the group. The phenomenal attack of the Czech Republic versus the organized defense and pragmatism of the United States.

Tune into the Czechia U17 vs United States U17 live stream on tutsport.net and follow this exciting battle at the FIFA U-17 World Cup!

Join us for the live broadcast of the final round of the group stage of the FIFA U-17 World Cup, where the New Zealand national team will face the Austria national team. This is a decisive game for both teams in the fight for second place and a spot in the knockout stage.

Date and Kick-off Time: November 11, 2025, 15:45 UTC 18:45 MSK.

Match Preview and Team Form

The New Zealand national team comes into this match with 3 points from two rounds. In their first match, the champions of Oceania defeated Iran 2-1, but then suffered a heavy 4-0 loss to Argentina. The team shows a fighting spirit but struggles in matches against strong opponents.

The Austria national team also has 3 points, having lost their opening match to Argentina 0-2 and then securing a victory over Iran 2-1. The European team displays organized and tactically astute football. The Austrians will be aiming for a win to guarantee their place in the playoffs.

Head-to-Head History

In their only head-to-head meeting, which took place in 2013, the New Zealand national team emerged victorious with a 4-2 scoreline.

New Zealand U17 vs Austria U17 Prediction

Experts and bookmakers consider the Austria national team the favorite for the upcoming match. Their superior class and tactical training are compelling arguments. It will be difficult for New Zealand to stand up to the organized European team, especially after a heavy defeat in the last round.

  • Key Factor: The battle for a spot in the playoffs. The tactical organization of Austria versus the fighting spirit of New Zealand.

Join us for the live broadcast of the final round of the group stage of the FIFA U-17 World Cup, where the Saudi Arabia national team will face the Mali national team. This is a decisive match for both teams, who each have one win and one loss and are fighting for a place in the knockout stage.

Match Preview and Team Form

The Saudi Arabia national team comes into this match in 3rd place in the group. The Asian Cup runners-up are playing good football in the tournament, demonstrating an organized game. In the opening two rounds, the Saudis secured one victory and suffered one defeat, scoring 3 goals and conceding 2. The team will be looking to at least avoid defeat to keep their chances of advancing from third place alive.

The Mali national team is in 2nd place in the group, also with one win and one loss. The African team, a finalist in the Africa Cup of Nations, is known for its physical power and speed. The Malians have been prolific, scoring 8 goals in their last five matches. In this match, they also need a positive result to guarantee their place in the next stage.

Head-to-Head History

There have been no previous official meetings between these youth national teams. This will be their first-ever head-to-head encounter.

Saudi Arabia U17 vs Mali U17 Prediction

Experts expect a very even and tense contest, as a spot in the playoffs is at stake. Bookmakers give a slight edge to the Saudi Arabia national team, which appears to be the more organized side. However, the physical power of the Malians could be a significant factor.
